ruleset_boundary.specialty_package_execution: Most specialty nodes remain GM-judgment in the current Trigger Discipline package even when their canonical rules text is locked/tertiary.
ruleset_boundary.networker_foothold_reason: The contained TD package has a FOOTHOLD hook. Hex retains her authored five-node selection; the new hook does not respec her.
ruleset_boundary.armed_drone_attacks: The Setting Oriel profile has no weapon/module or attack profile. Armed drones require the contained Ruleset operation and an explicitly supplied compatible weapon; this profile supplies neither.
ruleset_boundary.vehicle_combat: not added; VEHICLES handles uncertain/demanding operation and vehicles remain scene objects/transport until an explicit subsystem exists
ruleset_boundary.projected_barrier_numbers: not standardized in v0.1; projected barriers use BARRIER/COVER logic but their Siren Protocol material numbers remain open
ruleset_boundary.burst_full_auto: Use the contained TD implementation when its actual weapon and ammunition prerequisites hold; no separate Setting formula.
ruleset_boundary.tube_fed_loading: Retain actual feed, shell, chamber and cycling state; inspect the contained Ruleset operations for supported loading paths and explicitly adjudicate any unsupported handling.
ruleset_boundary.general_ready_stow: Use the contained Ruleset handling operations with explicitly justified costs; no new default costs or starting allowances are selected.

canon_effect.note: These are authored defaults. Rebalancing or rebuilding this profile does not retcon Siren Protocol setting fiction.

current_adapter: See SOURCE.md for the current exact format-4 containment and source provenance; earlier commit fields are historical.
